patch.value: Measure and reduce registry rebuilding during dependency batch mutations

The corrected create/update dependency parser resolves the active relationship registry during per-entry normalization and again during kind admission. A large batch therefore repeatedly rebuilds the same registered ontology and payload schema snapshots. Measure this cost and reuse a coherent registry snapshot per parse or mutation scope while retaining legacy diagnostics and extension isolation.

Measure realistic builtin and custom payload-schema batches; retain active aliases, refusal bytes and legacy diagnostics; exercise concurrent workspace contexts; keep public SDK and original performance budgets intact.
Large dependency batches reuse the active ontology coherently with a measured allocation or latency improvement and no contract changes.
